tree: Common questions about HoloTab, including how to use it, safety, privacy, and support.

items.question: What is HoloTab?
items.answer: HoloTab is a free AI browser companion from H Company: a Chrome extension that opens as a side panel, navigates websites and takes action for you on the tasks you'd rather skip. It works on virtually any website without integrations, shows its reasoning live, and can save tasks as Routines that run on a schedule.

items.question: What can HoloTab do?
items.answer: HoloTab automates real-world tasks across the web: it summarizes unread emails and drafts replies in your tone for approval, finds and books restaurant tables and syncs them to your calendar, researches flights and hotels to build a day-by-day itinerary within budget, and drafts marketplace listings on eBay and Vinted at market prices. You can type a task, speak it, record it as a routine, or schedule it.

items.question: Which model powers HoloTab?
items.answer: HoloTab runs on Holo4, our newest model family: Holo4 27B by default for complex tasks, or Holo4 35B-A3B for fast, simple ones. The same models power the Agents API and are available on the Models API.

items.question: How is HoloTab different from Comet or OpenClaw?
items.answer: HoloTab is a lightweight Chrome side panel, not a full browser replacement. It focuses on fast, visible, everyday automation (Routines, scheduling, and voice), and it is free and easy to install.

items.question: How do I download HoloTab?
items.answer: HoloTab is free and available on the Chrome Web Store. Install it, pin it to your toolbar, then click the extension icon to open the side panel and start your first task.

items.question: What are routines? How can I use them?
items.answer: Routines let you teach HoloTab a task once and reuse it. Show it the steps a single time, and it turns them into a saved automation you can run on demand or schedule to repeat automatically.

items.question: How do you address the security concerns raised by ANSSI/CERT-FR regarding agentic AI tools?
items.answer: We follow the guidance published by ANSSI and CERT-FR on agentic AI: HoloTab runs with least-privilege access, surfaces every action it takes in real time, and lets you pause or stop it instantly. We also run regular red-team testing against prompt injection and other adversarial scenarios.

items.question: Am I responsible for what HoloTab does?
items.answer: You stay in control. HoloTab shows its reasoning and actions as it works, and you can review, pause, or redirect it at any point before a task completes. We recommend supervising sensitive actions like payments or messages until you're familiar with how it behaves.

items.question: What are the best practices for using HoloTab safely?
items.answer: Start with low-stakes tasks, review Routines before scheduling them, avoid sharing highly sensitive credentials in a prompt, and keep the side panel open so you can watch HoloTab's actions as they happen.

items.question: What should I do if HoloTab starts behaving unexpectedly?
items.answer: Click Stop in the side panel to halt the task immediately. You can review the action log to see exactly what happened, then report it to us at support@hcompany.ai so we can investigate.

items.question: How do I know what HoloTab is doing at any given moment?
items.answer: The side panel streams HoloTab's reasoning live: which tab it's on, what it's reading, and what it's about to do next, so nothing happens off-screen.

items.question: What is a prompt injection attack?
items.answer: It's when malicious instructions hidden in a webpage try to hijack an agent's behavior. HoloTab is built to recognize and resist these attempts, and you can always interrupt a task if something looks off.

items.question: What are the main risks of using HoloTab?
items.answer: As with any agent that can act on your behalf, the main risks are unintended actions on sensitive accounts or sites with malicious content. Reviewing actions in real time and starting with lower-stakes tasks minimizes this.

items.question: What autonomy modes are available, and which should I use?
items.answer: HoloTab offers a supervised mode, where it asks for confirmation before key actions, and an autonomous mode, where it completes routines end to end. We recommend supervised mode for anything involving payments or messages, and autonomous mode for routines you've already reviewed.

items.question: How does HoloTab ensure your privacy and safety?
items.answer: Your data stays tied to your account and is never used to train models without consent. HoloTab only accesses the tabs and information needed to complete the task you've described. The Chrome extension is covered by H Company's Privacy Policy.

items.question: Can I review what HoloTab is doing?
items.answer: Yes. Every action appears in the side panel as it happens, and you can open the full activity log at any time to see exactly what was read, clicked, or typed.

items.question: How does HoloTab work on websites without integrations?
items.answer: HoloTab doesn't rely on API integrations. It navigates the visual interface the way a person would (clicking, typing, and reading the page), so it works on virtually any website without setup.
